## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran the changed-file pre-commit hooks.
- [x] I reviewed the applicable repository and test AGENTS.md rules.
- [ ] I added the required labels. The contributor account cannot set upstream labels; requested: `cat-bugfix`, `area:sparse_attention`, `op:DSA`, `orig-external`.

## Affected area

FE OSS CuTeDSL kernels: the SM100-family block-scaled unified indexer scorer, shared by MXFP8 and MXFP4.

## Summary

The load warp writes the per-head weight tile into two rotating shared-memory slots, but neither the Q/K tensor-memory pipeline nor tile parity publishes all 32 lanes of these stores to both epilogue warpgroups. The next tile can also overwrite a slot before both groups have finished reading it. A numerical reference can pass despite these unordered accesses.

Add a two-stage `PipelineAsync` with all 32 load lanes as producers and all 256 epilogue lanes as consumers. The producer acquires before writing a slot and commits the weights; both consumer warpgroups wait before the epilogue and release after it finishes. The existing output interface, score computation and Q/K pipelines are unchanged.

Related to #2244, which fixes the separately implemented BF16 dense score mainloop; that PR explicitly excludes MXFP8/MXFP4.

## Validation

On a B300 (SM103), cuDNN 9.27.0.42, PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, CuTeDSL 4.8.1/cu13 and Compute Sanitizer 2026.2.1:

- Six new sanitizer regression cases passed: racecheck and synccheck for MXFP8 H4, MXFP4 H4 with empty/partial rows, and MXFP4 H64 persistent multi-block reuse. On develop the same selection produced 3 racecheck failures and 3 synccheck passes; on this change all six passed.
- Existing indexer selection: 36 passed, 43 deselected, covering MXFP8/MXFP4, small heads, variable-length tails and persistent work.
- Cold-compiled reference cases for MXFP8 H4 and MXFP4 H4/H64 passed with each of CuTeDSL 4.8.0/cu12, 4.8.0/cu13, 4.8.1/cu12 and 4.8.1/cu13. The CUDA 13 framework/backend and driver were retained; the compiler flavors report CUDA 12.9 and 13.4. An initial 4.8.0/cu12 environment failed to discover its runtime; the separately installed retry loaded CUDA 12.9 and passed.
- Changed-weight CUDA Graph replay matched eager scores. A short replay-only ABBA experiment gave base medians 8.22/8.22 us and fix medians 14.08/8.23 us, with one noisy fix run; these samples do not establish a performance conclusion.
- Changed-file pre-commit hooks and `git diff --check` passed.

Thank you for your contribution! No new correctness finding. The two-stage pipeline publishes every load lane's weight stores and waits for both epilogue groups before slot reuse. The producer and both consumers advance only for valid work tiles, including tiles with no visible keys.

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Check warp-role shared-memory publication in the SM100-family block-scaled indexer forward."""
+
+import os
+import shutil
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+
+@pytest.mark.L1
+@pytest.mark.gpu_exclusive
+@pytest.mark.xdist_group(name="gpu_exclusive")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tool", ["racecheck", "synccheck"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "case",
+    [
+        pytest.param("test_DSA_indexer_forward_wrapper_mxfp8_small_head_groups_match_dequant_reference[4]", id="mxfp8-h4"),
+        pytest.param("test_DSA_indexer_forward_wrapper_mxfp4_matches_dequant_reference[qh4_b3_key_tail]", id="mxfp4-h4-empty-tail"),
+        pytest.param("test_DSA_indexer_forward_wrapper_mxfp4_matches_dequant_reference[qh64_ratio4_persistent_mixed_blocks]", id="mxfp4-h64-persistent"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_indexer_forward_sm100_blockscaled_sanitizer(case, tool):
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] != 10:
+        pytest.skip("requires SM100-family")
+    toolkit_sanitizer = Path(os.environ.get("CUDA_HOME", "/usr/local/cuda")) / "bin" / "compute-sanitizer"
+    sanitizer = str(toolkit_sanitizer) if toolkit_sanitizer.is_file() and os.access(toolkit_sanitizer, os.X_OK) else shutil.which("compute-sanitizer")
+    if sanitizer is None:
+        sanitizer = next((str(p) for p in sorted(Path("/usr/local").glob("cuda*/bin/compute-sanitizer"))), None)
+    if sanitizer is None:
+        pytest.skip("compute-sanitizer is not installed")
+    test_timeout = float(os.environ.get("CUDNN_TEST_TIMEOUT", "1500"))
+    timeout = min(300.0, 0.6 * test_timeout) if test_timeout > 0 else 300.0
+    child = f"import faulthandler,sys; faulthandler.dump_traceback_later({timeout * 0.9!r}); import pytest; sys.exit(pytest.main(sys.argv[1:]))"
+    target = Path(__file__).with_name("test_DSA_indexer_forward.py").resolve()
+    cmd = [
+        sanitizer,
+        "--tool",
+        tool,
+        "--report-api-errors",
+        "no",
+        "--error-exitcode",
+        "9",
+        "--print-limit",
+        "10",
+        sys.executable,
+        "-u",
+        "-c",
+        child,
+        f"{target}::{case}",
+        "-n0",
+        "-o",
+        "addopts=",
+        "-p",
+        "no:cacheprovider",
+        "-q",
+    ]
+    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, start_new_session=True)
+    try:
+        out, _ = proc.communicate(timeout=timeout)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+        rest, _ = proc.communicate()
+        prior = exc.output.decode(errors="replace") if isinstance(exc.output, bytes) else (exc.output or "")
+        raise AssertionError(f"{tool} timed out after {timeout}s\n{prior}{rest}") from None
+    assert proc.returncode == 0, out[-8000:]
+    assert "1 passed" in out, out[-8000:]
+    summary = "ERROR SUMMARY: 0 errors" if tool == "synccheck" else "0 errors, 0 warnings"
+    assert summary in out, out[-8000:]
